notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon has been released! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I'm writing a quick devlog to let you know that my most recent visual novel, [i]My Lovey-Dovey Demon[/i], has been released! Yay \o/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e869aec72dd4182535668ade5c2d4530d9819120.jpg[/img]

You can check the VN out here, if you're interested:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

[i]MLDD[/i] is a VN that's been in process for quite a while. I wrote the script back in 2021, and it took me a while to piece the whole story together. The Steam store page was up for over a year before I finally released it, so some people have been waiting on this one for a while haha

It might have taken me some time to finish this project, but I tried to use this time to ensure that it's as polished as possible! The main artist, [url=https://twitter.com/Kimoreen]Kimoreen[/url], did a great job with the character artwork, and all of the cute chibi cut-ins by [url=https://twitter.com/Konayachi]Konayachi[/url] are adorable!

I also had some help from Harmonie of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44509628]Asminae Games[/url], who created Reborn a Zombie (available for free on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283350]Steam[/url]), to do some work on the various visual effects in this VN. That means this VN has some fun effects during the CGs which I've not added to any of my previous projects such as light rays, animated particles, and moving fog. I think it helps the VN pop, and it brings the story to life!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/76da6cae1c84a845dd2d5c2968af720c4f21c4b5.png[/img]

Speaking of the story, it's a pretty cute, light affair which takes a lot of cues from typical BxG slice of life VNs. It's quite chill and relaxed, and there isn't much in the way of conflict (which might be a bit of a rarity coming from me lol), so this should be a good read if you're looking for something cosy. It's pretty similar to [i]The Language of Love[/i] in that it's a wholesome BxG romance story, though it has a bit more of a comedy focus like [i]My Dear Prince[/i].

Everybody put a lot of effort into this VN, so I hope you all enjoy it! ♡

As always, let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the VN, and I'll try to fix them up within a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x

notes.title: Strawberry Vinegar Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just to let you know, I uploaded a new build of Strawberry Vinegar. This update changed a few things, including:

[list]
[*] slightly edited/updated UI
[*] a complete rework of the CG gallery code
[*] updated sound effects
[*] some small edits to the text (mostly rewording the odd sentence here and there I thought was awkward/stilted)
[*] and the sprites have blinking animations now. Amazing!!!
[/list]

I also compressed the sprites a bit, so now they take up less space. The game is about 500MB smaller because of it, so it should be quicker to download!

These are all rather minor changes all around, but hopefully it adds some polish to this rather old release and brings it more in-line quality-wise with my newer releases.

If you find any problems with the new build, such as achievements refusing to trigger, typos, or graphical bugs, please feel free to tell me.

Thank you for your continued support! It's appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Strawberry Vinegar update
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Just letting everyone know that I recently released an update for this VN.

In this update, I...

1) Fixed a lot of typos and grammatical errors, as pointed out to me by a helpful proofreader
2) Edited a handful of scenes to make them 'flow' a bit better
3) Edited the animated fireworks effect, so it should no longer cause eye strain
4) Updated the game to the newest build of Ren'py, which should help it run more smoothly. Maybe?
[strike]Well, the conversion certainly broke a bunch of my old code, which meant I had to redo it. Let's hope it was not in vain.[/strike]

If you find any more typos/bugs in this new build, be sure to let me know! I appreciate all your feedback!

- ebi x

notes.title: Blackberry Honey now on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just letting you know, my newest yuri visual novel, Blackberry Honey, has been released on Steam! And, despite the title, it's not really that similar to Strawberry Vinegar, haha ;;; (I'm just not good at titles).

Blackberry Honey is set in the Victorian era in England, and it's about the love story between two lesbian maids. It has mature content and a happy ending, and it's a little longer than Strawberry Vinegar. The writing is also a little 'fancier'.

You can check it out here, if you want! It's $12.99, with a 10% launch discount!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/716340/Blackberry_Honey/

- ebi x

notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Just letting you know, I have uploaded a new build of this VN to Steam. The new build includes:

* A handful of remade background images (mostly for the interior scenes)
* A couple of edited CGs
* Various typo corrections
* Some new, higher quality sound effects in place of the old ones

There isn't much that's new about this build, but the new art assets make it look quite a bit prettier. Selly's background art has become so good over the last year, it's really amazing o'A'o

And, if you're interested in trying my newest game with her art, it can be found here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/628460/Lily_of_the_Valley/

Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi guys! ///

I updated the build of SV to fix some spelling errors (finally...) These were pointed out a while ago, so I guess it's a bit bad I only got around to doing it now... But better late than never, I suppose...?

In addition, I also added an option to change the textbox in the game. I got a few comments from people saying the textbox was too pale and it was hard to read the white text against it, so now there are five (a whole five!) different textboxes to choose from.

I also updated ren'py to the newest version to create this build, so I'm a bit concerned saves may no longer be compatible across versions... I don't think there is anything I can do about it, but please let me know if your saves work or not.

Thank you!

- Ebi xxx
